asset_manifests.name: High-Precision GNSS Receiver
asset_manifests.visual_identity: A professional-grade satellite positioning system; features a bright orange 'smart' pole topped with a white, saucer-shaped GNSS antenna. A ruggedized field tablet is clamped to the pole at chest height, showing a topographic map of the Morrison Formation with blue 'GPS fix' icons. The base of the pole has a sharp steel tip for precise ground placement.
asset_manifests.notes: Used primarily by Paleontologist 04 to record the exact coordinates of the Centrosaurus bone bed. The orange pole matches the project's consistent industrial tool aesthetic.
